keyword.zh: 电动40和柴油40混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动40和柴油40混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Both name a Kawasaki 112, but Electric 40 prints a 45 kW motor and Diesel 40 prints a 4108 engine at 66 kW.
description.zh: 两边都写川崎112，但电动40印 45 kW 电机，柴油40印 4108 发动机 66 kW。

h1.zh: 电动40和柴油40混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 40 and Diesel 40 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and fine-stone 120 m / 360 m. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa and distance 120 m / 360 m. Both print Kawasaki 112 and a 0.4 m³ hopper. Diesel 40's specification table does not print an aggregate-size row.
directAnswer.zh: 电动40和柴油40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m。两边都印川崎112和料斗 0.4 m³。柴油40的规格表没有骨料粒径行。

heading.en: Where Electric 40 and Diesel 40 print different values
heading.zh: 电动40和柴油40哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h; Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 40 prints 23 MPa; Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa. Dimensions: Electric 40 prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Main unit weight: Electric 40 prints 2300 kg; Diesel 40 prints 2800 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages; Hydraulic pump is Kawasaki 112 on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动40印 21 m³/h；柴油40印 26 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动40印 23 MPa；柴油40印 25 MPa。外形尺寸：电动40印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm；柴油40印 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。整机重量：电动40印 2300 kg；柴油40印 2800 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³；液压泵两边都是 Kawasaki 112。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 40 prints cells that Diesel 40 does not: Motor power 45 kW; Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m; Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m. Diesel 40 prints cells that Electric 40 does not: Diesel engine power 4108 / 66 kW; Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 360 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动40有、柴油40没有的行：电机功率 45 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m。柴油40有、电动40没有的行：柴油机功率 4108 / 66 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: A shared Kawasaki 112 line does not make the drive or the output the same. Open /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric 40 and /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 液压泵都写川崎112，并不表示动力或产量相同。看电动40请打开 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/，看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 40 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 电动40和柴油40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h. Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40印 21 m³/h。柴油40印 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 40 print the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 电动40和柴油40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 23 MPa. Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40印 23 MPa。柴油40印 25 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 40 print the same dimensions as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 电动40和柴油40的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。柴油40印 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 40?
question.zh: 为什么柴油40没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 40 page does not print that label. Electric 40 prints 45 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油40这一页没有印这个标题。电动40印的是 45 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
